inputs.original_text: Workers employed in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth staged a protest outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike, calling for legally binding job security guarantees — even as the government argued it had already delivered on the most significant demands. At the heart of the [...]
inputs.modified_text:
Look at what is happening to the foundational duties of our public institutions. On Thursday, workers in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth staged a protest outside the Presidential Palace and announced a 24-hour strike. 

Instead of showing personal responsibility and respecting the government—which has already delivered on the most significant demands—these agitators are demanding legally binding job security guarantees. They are deliberately choosing to disrupt the system.

This behavior strikes right at the heart of our traditional values and the fabric of our society. When individuals abandon their duty and demand unconditional guarantees instead of earning their place through honest work, it shows a total collapse of respect for governance and the rule of law. We must stand firm against this kind of chaos and uphold authority.
